svg.title: Synchronous Chess — AWS infrastructure
svg.desc: The players' browsers load the Angular app from CloudFront and a private S3 bucket, list the rooms through an HTTP API and join them through a WebSocket API of API Gateway, both backed by Lambda functions, which store the rooms in Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 through its Data API. The game itself runs peer to peer over WebRTC.
